newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia cenbank OKs $1.8 bln overseas bonds in 97.
newsitem.headline: Colombia cenbank OKs $1.8 bln overseas bonds in 97.

text.p: Colombia's central bank announced Friday it had authorized the issuance of $1.8 billion in bonds to be sold in foreign markets in 1997.
In a statement, the bank said the bonds would be for terms of more than five years.
In 1995, the central bank issued $1.4 billion bonds in foreign capital markets.
The central bank said the interest rates would be fixed or variable depending on prevailing market conditions when the debt is sold. No dates have been set for the bonds.

"The No.1 priority for placing bonds in 1997 will be to obtain financial resources on ever better terms using a mixture of maturities and costs," Finance Minister Jose Antonio Ocampo said in an interview with Reuters earlier this week.
The central bank said it would issue 5.28 trillion pesos in Treasury bonds to local markets in 1997 to fund part of the national budget.
